source_note: 对含参数方程根的估计
english_source_note: Estimates for Roots of Parameterized Equations
callout_id: 对含参数方程根的估计#3
statement_en:
Let the \(N(s)\) positive roots of \(\cos(x)=sx\) be ordered as
\\[
x_1(s)<x_2(s)<\\cdots<x_{N(s)}(s).
\\]
Then:
1. \(N(s)\\sim \\frac{1}{\\pi s}\).
2. For every \(1\\leq k\\leq N(s)\),
\\[
k\\pi<x_k(s)<(k+1)\\pi.
\\]
key_techniques: monotonicity and sign changes of trigonometric functions
callout_body:
设$\cos(x)=sx$的$N(s)$个正根按照顺序排列为$$x_1(s)<x_2(s)<\cdots<x_{N(s)}(s)$$那么:
1. $N(s)\sim \frac{1}{\pi s}$
2. 对于$1\leq k\leq N(s)$都有$$k\pi<x_k(s)<(k+1)\pi$$
